children: Michael Kliger, an officer serving as Chief Executive Officer, reported direct sales of ordinary shares in two transactions on October 8 and October 9, 2026. The transactions were executed at $10.36 and $10.24 per share, resulting in a weighted average sale price of $10.33 per share. The total sale proceeds reported were $750,725. Following the reported transactions, Kliger no longer directly owns any ordinary shares.
